title: Images fit into more existing workflows
summary:
Images became easier to generate and edit, while new models, connected community apps, and a pixel-art front door made more of Pollinations accessible.

OpenAI-compatible generation and edit endpoints were added, accepting prompts and source images from URLs or uploads, with base64 or URL responses. The compatible model list also expanded to include permitted image and audio models alongside text. In the playground, image generation gained support for a supplied API key.

New alpha options covered realistic and complex-scene images with Dirtberry and Dirtberry Pro, speech with Qwen3 TTS, and text with Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Seraphyn’s GPT-5.4 option. Pruna added image generation, image editing, and text- or image-to-video models. Nanobanana-2 and Nanobanana Pro also gained a smaller 0.5K image tier.

A run of image-service changes addressed avoidable blocks and rejected requests. Nanobanana stopped adding safety instructions to every prompt and limits its extra pre-check to `safe=true`; GPT image models changed endpoints to address content-policy blocks. Fixed legacy backends, GPT Image edit endpoint fixes, and Klein request changes tackled routing and request failures.

Product Packaging Designer and AI Dungeon Master added Pollinations account connection so people can use their own Pollen. Those apps and Virtual Makeup added media uploads, while AI Dungeon Master gained an Adventure Gallery. CatGPT added Pollinations login, selfie uploads, and a Pollen balance view. The app catalog was deduplicated, and Gratisfy joined it.
